entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. A small intensely golden suspended bead containing coiled orange fire under tension, heat ribbons slowly gathering inward, not yet exploded. Show compact poised energy rather than flying fireball. No clock.
